visualCharacteristics.purpose: Centred bordered step cards: photo on top, full-width coloured label bar (purple, navy, cyan by position), short description; "exchange" option draws → / ← arrows between two cards
visualCharacteristics.description: cards-product has linked titles and lists; cards-icon is borderless icon tiles; cards-resource is title-over-cover with Read button. This is unlinked photo-top cards with a per-position coloured label bar (purple, navy, cyan) under the image: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: 3 centered bordered step cards: cover photo, full-width coloured label bar (purple / navy / cyan, uppercase), short description / 2 step cards ('With Carousel' purple bar, 'With Plate' cyan bar) with a stacked → / ← arrow pair between them
contentPattern.structure: one row per card: (1) image (`image`/`imageAlt`); (2) rich text `text`: bold label paragraph (e.g. FIRST STEP) + description paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for short illustrated process steps. Add the Exchange option for a two-card swap (bars purple then cyan). For linked numbered product steps use cards-workflow.
usageDescription: Centred bordered step cards: photo on top, full-width coloured label bar (purple, navy, cyan by position), short description; "exchange" option draws → / ← arrows between two cards.
